text:
maya_cs: Quick heads-up — Momentix onboarding: tail latency creeping on their chat route during spikes. Saw p95 jump from 220ms -> 680ms on Wed morning. Want to propose a small quant/model-routing play before renewal check-in. 
liam_se: Thanks Maya. Do we have recent traces? Any pattern (seq len, burst size)?
maya_cs: Sequence lengths steady ~180 tokens. Spikes align with batch bursts from their mobile clients (sudden fan-out). I attached link to the p95 graph: https://redwood.internal/graphs/momentix/p95
raja_sre: If seq len ~180, int8 quant might be risky for quality but int4/compact could be fine depending on model. What's the model in use?
maya_cs: They're on rw-ggml-large-v1 (our hosted variant). Quality bar is medium — they accept occasional minor paraphrase differences but not hallucinations.
liam_se: Options: 1) Prefix cache for common prompts (reduces compute), 2) Route short bursts to dedicated pool (low-latency), 3) Try compact-int4 canary with canary routing + fallback.
olivia_pe: Renewal in 6 weeks. If we can show 30% latency reduction with <1% quality delta on eval set, it's a strong renewal signal. Can CS run a quick eval?
maya_cs: I'll collect 200 recent customer prompts and mark 30 golden ones for quality, will share by EOD.
raja_sre: I'll prepare two canaries: compact-int4 (quantized) and a compact-ffn-optimized variant. Routing policy: 10% traffic -> canaries, 90% -> current. Fallback: immediate switch to baseline on any error or quality regression alert.
liam_se: Helpful config snippet for the routing rule (for ops):
```
route: momentix_chat
policies:
  - name: compact-canary
    weight: 0.10
    constraints:
      - model: [rw-ggml-compact-int4, rw-ggml-compact-ffn]
      - max_latency: 500ms
  - name: baseline
    weight: 0.90
    model: rw-ggml-large-v1
fallback: baseline
```
raja_sre: Also enable prefix/KV cache for their common system prompts; that cut token work by ~18% on a previous account.
maya_cs: I'll coordinate an enablement session with their eng lead Thu 11am PT. Olivia, can you join to present the savings narrative?
olivia_pe: Yes, I'll join. Also let's prep a renewal-facing slide: before/after latency, cost per 1M tokens, quality delta on the eval set.
deploy-bot: Canary deployment queued: compact-canary -> rw-ggml-compact-int4 (10%) scheduled 2026-04-05T19:00:00Z.
maya_cs: Perfect. Post-canary we'll run A/B eval on the 30 golden prompts + live quality alerts for 24h. If pass -> bump to 40% and capture cost metrics.
liam_se: If quality delta >0.5% on golden set, auto rollback. Monitor for hallucination patterns.
raja_sre: I'll also add tracing hooks: token-level latency and KV cache hit rate.
maya_cs: Thanks all. I'll post the collected prompts and invite list in the customer thread. :thumbsup:
